projection.purpose: Preserve spatial identity between authored scene information, browser previews and engine-facing models.

contract.input: A versioned scene contract with stable objects, transforms, locations and camera references.
contract.step: Validate scene identities and coordinate conventions before conversion.
Project the same model into a Three.js location preview and a future Unreal adapter.
contract.invariant: A spatial preview is a production view, not another gameplay authority.
contract.reject: Do not claim completed engine acceptance from a diagram or planned API.

test.given: An asymmetric scene fixture with identifiable transforms.
test.when: Future browser and engine adapters convert the fixture.
test.then: Compare object identity, orientation and placement by declared tolerances.
